Refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund has been issued but has not appeared in the account.
activate_my_card: How to activate a newly received physical bank card.
age_limit: Minimum age and age eligibility for opening or using an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Adding or using a card in Apple Pay or Google Pay.
atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines support withdrawing with this card.
automatic_top_up: Set up, change, disable or understand automatic account top-ups.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: An incoming bank transfer is not reflected in the account balance.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cash or cheque deposit is missing from the account balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer recipient or beneficiary is not permitted.
cancel_transfer: Cancel a bank transfer that was requested or scheduled.
card_about_to_expire: Renewing or replacing a card because its expiration date is approaching.
card_acceptance: Where a card is accepted, including merchants and countries.
card_arrival: A physical card has not arrived or the customer asks where it is.
card_delivery_estimate: Expected delivery duration or estimated arrival date for a card.
card_linking: Link an existing card to an account or app.
card_not_working: A card generally does not work, with no more specific cause given.
card_payment_fee_charged: An unexpected fee or surcharge was charged for a card purchase.
card_payment_not_recognised: A card purchase is unfamiliar or was not authorized by the customer.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase seems wrong.
card_swallowed: An ATM retained or swallowed the physical card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal is unfamiliar or unauthorized.
change_pin: Change or reset the card's PIN code.
compromised_card: Card details may have been compromised, copied or used fraudulently.
contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay card payments do not work.
country_support: Countries of residence supported for opening or holding an account.
declined_card_payment: A particular card purchase was declined or rejected.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM rejected a request to withdraw cash.
declined_transfer: A bank transfer was explicitly declined or rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit payment is unfamiliar or unauthorized.
disposable_card_limits: Limits, restrictions and allowed uses of disposable virtual cards.
edit_personal_details: Update personal profile information such as name, address or contact details.
exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency.
exchange_rate: How exchange rates are determined or which current exchange rate applies.
exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies using the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: An extra small charge or unexplained additional statement entry.
failed_transfer: A transfer failed to complete rather than remaining pending.
fiat_currency_support: Which ordinary fiat currencies an account can hold or exchange.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Create or obtain a disposable virtual card.
get_physical_card: Availability, eligibility or how to obtain a physical card.
getting_spare_card: Obtain an additional or spare physical card.
getting_virtual_card: Create or obtain a reusable virtual card.
lost_or_stolen_card: A physical card has been lost or stolen; blocking or replacing it.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone used for the banking account has been lost or stolen.
order_physical_card: Place or manage an order for a physical bank card.
passcode_forgotten: The app login passcode has been forgotten; regain account access.

pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM withdrawal remains pending in the account.
pending_top_up: A card top-up remains pending rather than completing.
pending_transfer: A bank transfer is still pending or awaiting processing.
pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked after too many incorrect attempts.
receiving_money: How another person can send money to the customer.
request_refund: How to request a refund for a card purchase or dispute a merchant payment.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed or reverted after initially appearing.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which funding cards and currencies are supported for card top-ups.

top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up the account with another bank card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Whether and how cash or cheques can fund the account.
top_up_failed: A card top-up failed or was unsuccessful.
top_up_limits: Minimum or maximum amounts and frequency limits for top-ups.
top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed and money returned to the funding card.
topping_up_by_card: How to add money to the account using a bank card.
transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction appears to have been charged twice.
transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for sending a bank transfer.
transfer_into_account: Bank details and steps for transferring money into the account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A sent transfer has not reached its intended recipient.
transfer_timing: How long a bank transfer normally takes to arrive.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or cannot be completed.
verify_my_identity: How to complete identity verification and which documents to provide.
verify_source_of_funds: Provide evidence or documents showing the source of deposited funds.
verify_top_up: Verify a funding card or card top-up, including a verification code.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working for payments.
visa_or_mastercard: Whether issued cards use Visa or Mastercard, and choosing a network.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate for an ATM cash withdrawal seems wrong.
